checkedAlternates.resolution: Hard hats protect the cranium from falling impact and electrical shock (group-4), whereas goggles/shields/respirators protect vision, face, and airways (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: A full-body harness wraps around the torso and thighs.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A fall-arrest harness is dedicated height-safety fall arrest equipment (group-1), distinct from impact/chemical barrier apparel (group-4).
